description:
Deletes an agenda and its timer history permanently. Its share and edit links stop working the
moment this returns, and nothing can be recovered. Meant for an agenda the user has explicitly
confirmed; the delete-agenda skill asks first.

release_agenda instead takes a saved agenda out of a linked account and keeps its share link
alive for a while. Returns {deleted: true, share_token}.

edit_token.description: The latest edit_token (from create_agenda, or rotate_edit_token after a rotation). Authorizes on its own; needed unless the agenda is saved to a linked account.

share_token.description: Agenda id (from create_agenda or list_agendas). Required with a linked account, optional beside edit_token.

name: delete_agenda
title: Delete an agenda
